# Provider Admission Generated Solution

This temporary Generated Solution is the executable acceptance seam for the
provider-admission and absence harness.

The fixture selects PostgreSQL for relational persistence, Quartz for durable
jobs, and Azure Blob for object storage on the exact
`modular-monolith/net10.0/linux` matrix coordinate. Its provider-admission record
proves selected effects and the absence of every unselected catalog provider.
The object-storage evidence records bounded streaming, cancellation, content
metadata, conditional operations, bounded retries, failure mapping, redaction,
health, outage behavior, and the required live-Azure parity gate. Invalid
selections are rejected before the generation callback can run.

Azurite evidence is deterministic and claim-free. Live-Azure evidence is
required before promotion; until it is attested the record remains fail-closed
and does not create a Supported Capability claim.
